note: Recorded verdicts for audit_mt5_capability_reuse rows (III.16 triage). Without this registry every weekly seat re-inspected the same modules and the verdicts evaporated -- the 2026-08-25 gap-wirer seat's ten libs.alpha inspections closed 'pending an audit disposition mechanism'; this is that mechanism. Verdicts: SUPERSEDED (an MT5-native organ owns the function; wiring would recreate the two-lineage disease) | BLOCKED (incompatible or banned-universe; the MT5-equivalence question is answered no). Anything positive-EV is neither: it gets WIRED and leaves the queue by measured reachability, never by verdict. Reachability always outranks a disposition -- a disposed module that gains a real MT5 consumer reports REACHABLE with the disposition marked stale. Reasons are mandatory and substantive; this file is tracked so git history is the audit trail.
